name: What kind of paint do you use for cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint do you use for cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: For cabinet painting, we use durable, high-quality paints specifically formulated for cabinetry. These professional-grade products are typically either acrylic-urethane or alkyd-urethane blends, known for their excellent adhesion, resistance to chipping, and smooth, hard finish. Unlike standard wall paints, cabinet-specific paints offer superior durability and can withstand the daily wear and tear of a kitchen environment. We select paints that provide both an attractive appearance and long-lasting performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use durable, professional-grade acrylic-urethane or alkyd-urethane paints specifically formulated for cabinetry to ensure a hard, chip-resistant finish.
